post.summary: Signs in and issues the auth cookie.
Clears the auth cookie.

get.summary: Everything the SPA needs at boot: identity, role, language and tenant settings.

put.summary: Updates the signed-in user's display name and language preference.

post.summary: Changes the signed-in user's own password and clears the forced-change flag.

get.summary: Lets the login screen render the Google button only where it can actually work.
Starts the Google flow. 404 when Google is not configured on this installation.
Signs in an existing, active, verified-e-mail user. Never creates one.
Lists entities. Members read; administrators write.

delete.summary: Soft-deactivates the entity; the ledger keeps referring to it forever.

get.summary: Lists departments — the teams that execute work, not the entities work is about.
Lists responsibilities. Owners can read; administrators write.

delete.summary: Deactivates the responsibility. Existing occurrences stay in the ledger.

post.summary: Pauses spawning through the end of the given local date. Skipped periods are never missed.
Hands the responsibility over. Future occurrences follow automatically; existing workable ones follow on request.

get.summary: The board and list views, and the target of every report drill-through.

post.summary: Creates a one-off task. Occurrences are engine-created and cannot be posted.

get.summary: The item with its event history, comments and the transitions currently allowed.

put.summary: Descriptive fields only. Status is never a PATCH — the rules live server-side.

post.summary: Marks the item as being worked on. Does not affect whether its period is missed.
Completes the item. A missed item completes as CompletedLate; the miss stands.
Puts the item on hold. The reason is mandatory; free text is mandatory when the reason is Other.
Releases a hold, or undoes a completion (owner or administrator).
Cancels a one-off task that no longer applies. Occurrences can never be cancelled.
Moves the due date. An occurrence may only move inside its own period.
Runs one action over up to 100 items through the existing single-item commands, reporting each result.

delete.summary: Deletes a comment. Author or administrator only; there is no edit.

post.summary: One file per request. Size and type are enforced server-side.

get.summary: The entity's full occurrence timeline interleaved with its one-off work.
The server owns the supported-language list; the client's picker renders from it, so the two cannot disagree.
Licence, version and source location. The AGPL requires an interactive interface to say so.
Streams the file to an authenticated caller. Never served as a static file.
Due today / completed today / overdue / missed in range / on hold by reason.
Per entity: open, overdue, missed 30/60/90d, on hold, days since last activity. Sortable server-side.
Entities with no completed activity in N days (default 90), oldest first.
On-hold work grouped by entity and reason, with the oldest hold in each group.
Compliance rate per responsibility, with the trend behind it. Sorted by misses first.
One responsibility: the same tally, its bucket series, and the ✅/❌/⏸ strip of its periods.
Per person, over occurrences only, with external waits shown beside the rate.
Completed work per entity per bucket — counts of work items, never hours.
Calendar days spent on hold, per reason and per entity, rebuilt from the event log.
Responsibilities with K misses in their last N periods. Feeds the dashboard block.
Lists users. Members see active users only; administrators see everything.

post.summary: Creates a user. There is no self-service registration in v1.

put.summary: Updates display name, role, language and active flag. Deactivated users keep their history.

post.summary: Administrator password reset. Always forces a change at the user's next login.
The departure path: everything this person owns becomes somebody else's, in one call.

put.summary: Name, IANA time zone, digest hour and default language.

get.summary: Scope, active flag and a redacted summary. Never a secret, not even to an administrator.
Derived from the delivery rows: pending, failed in the last day, and the last error.

put.summary: Saves this tenant's credentials for one channel.

delete.summary: Removes this tenant's credentials. Any system-scope fallback applies again afterwards.

post.summary: Sends one message to the caller — the only honest way to test a channel.

get.summary: The signed-in user's notifications, newest first.
One integer, polled by the bell. Cheaper than a socket at this scale.

post.summary: Marks the given notifications read, or all of them when no ids are sent.

put.summary: Choosing a channel you have no address on is refused rather than silently ignored.

post.summary: Issues a single-use code and the deep link that carries it to the bot.

get.summary: Own subscription; administrators see everyone's, because it is a distribution list.

put.summary: Upsert: there is exactly one subscription per person.

get.summary: Personal only — shared views are a permissions question, and permissions are v3.

post.summary: Saving the same name again replaces it.
Adds an ad-hoc item. Always non-required — only the template decides what blocks a completion.

delete.summary: Ad-hoc items only. A template item is part of what the occurrence was asked to do.

put.summary: Replaces the ordered template. Existing occurrences keep the snapshot they spawned with.

get.summary: Display-only reference fields. Never filterable, sortable or reportable — see the guardrails.

put.summary: The field type is not editable: changing it would leave every stored value invalid.

delete.summary: Values stored under it are ignored on read and dropped on the entity's next save.

get.summary: Exactly the rows the work list shows for the same filters.
entity-health | neglect | blocked-by-entity
compliance | reliability | concentration | hold-aging
A streamed table dump for analysis. Uncapped: there is no aggregation here to be wrong.

post.summary: Parses and validates without writing anything. Returns a suggested column mapping.
Creates the valid rows, skips duplicates, and reports each failure with its row number.
Returns the token once. Everdue stores only its prefix and a SHA-256 hash and cannot show it again.

delete.summary: Revokes immediately. The row is kept, because 'this key existed and was withdrawn' is the answer somebody needs.

get.summary: Subscriptions. The signing secret is never returned — the DTO has no field for it.

post.summary: Returns the signing secret once. Verify with it as described in docs/api.md.

get.summary: The six subscribable events, with the names they carry on the wire.
Pending / failed-in-24h / last error per subscription, derived from the deliveries table.

put.summary: Sending active:true also re-enables an auto-disabled subscription and resets its failure count.

post.summary: Queues one signed `ping`, so a receiver can be proved before it is trusted.

get.summary: Whether this install holds demo data, whether that can be changed here, and what the confirmation must say.

post.summary: Turns demo mode on or off. BOTH DIRECTIONS DELETE EVERY WORK ITEM, RESPONSIBILITY, ENTITY AND USER IN THE TENANT except the caller, and cannot be undone. Requires the workspace name typed out and the caller's own password. 404 when Demo:AllowReset is off.
